title: The goal line of a worker's brief says stop after 60 turns whatever cap dispatch gives
goal: bl_items.cmd_goal ends every goal text with 'or stop after 60 turns', and the brief includes that text, so a research task or subtask dispatched with --max-turns 200 (ST-php5itob) or a story with 100 is told to stop at 60. The goal line names the cap bl_dispatch.max_turns gives the item (or --max-turns), so the brief and the session's limit agree. Found by the SP-qg7ncs6d review.

run: import subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run(['python3','_tools/backlog.py','goal','BG-i4fxvd2h'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(1 if r.returncode or 'stop after 60 turns' in r.stdout else 0)
